findings.finding: read_ref calls Path.read_bytes before checking actual length. Declaration bytes <=128MiB is not a bound on the actual pre-guard read. Request/config/harness/snapshot/payload/readiness/observation/guard source are read this way before SourceReadGuard.acquire.
findings.expected: Bound each pre-guard read to declared expected length plus one byte, rejecting oversize/short/hash drift; preserve exact raw bytes and original references. Retain SourceReadGuard for held-copy and total/per-file enforcement.
findings.observed_via: Independent static source/dataflow review; no malformed resource or archive invocation executed.
findings.other_scope: The actual selected file copy already obtains guarded buffers; this finding concerns early read_ref only. No plaintext key/DB was read.
